title: Boston Open Space
description: City of Boston open spaces and parks, playgrounds, athletic fields, conservation land, and cemeteries, 1,012 polygons from the City of Boston GIS open data platform. Official primary source, republished as cloud-native GeoParquet with a PMTiles visualization and MapLibre styles.

table:columns.name: SITE_NAME
table:columns.description: Best-known or official site name. Multi-parcel sites carry Roman numeral suffixes, Stony Brook Reservation I and II.

table:columns.name: OWNERSHIP
table:columns.description: Fee owner where known. City of Boston, Commonwealth of Massachusetts, private owners, and agency abbreviations like BRA and BNAN.

table:columns.name: PROTECTION
table:columns.description: Slash-separated legal protection instruments. A97 is Article 97 of the Massachusetts Constitution, the strongest. Free text, match with LIKE.

table:columns.name: TYPECODE
table:columns.description: Numeric open space type 1 through 7. Disagrees with TypeLong on about 13 rows, treat TypeLong as closer to intent.

table:columns.name: DISTRICT
table:columns.description: Planning district per the city's open space plan, not the official neighborhood boundaries. Includes the non-spatial value Multi-District.

table:columns.name: ACRES
table:columns.description: Official area in acres of the open-space portion, the figure to use instead of computing geometry area.

table:columns.name: ADDRESS
table:columns.description: Street address if known, null for 589 rows.

table:columns.name: ZonAgg
table:columns.description: Aggregated zoning district, for example Open Space District.

table:columns.name: TypeLong
table:columns.description: Open space type as text, with minor spelling variants worth normalizing before grouping.

table:columns.name: OS_Own_Jur
table:columns.description: The entity holding the open-space rights. BPRD, DCR, the Boston Conservation Commission, or None.

table:columns.name: OS_Mngmnt
table:columns.description: Managing entity only when it differs from OS_Own_Jur. Null means the steward manages it, not missing data.

table:columns.name: POS
table:columns.description: Protected open space flag. X permanently protected, N not.

table:columns.name: PA
table:columns.description: Public access flag. X accessible, A by appointment, N no or unknown access.

table:columns.name: ALT_NAME
table:columns.description: Official, previous, or colloquial alternate names.

table:columns.name: AgncyJuris
table:columns.description: Agency of jurisdiction for government-owned unprotected sites. Sparsely populated by design.

table:columns.name: ShapeSTAre
table:columns.description: ArcGIS-computed area in square meters from the source State Plane geometry.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Site geometry, WGS84 longitude and latitude.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct, the GeoParquet covering.
